assets.brick.png: Use case: style-transfer, production 2D game sprite. Replace the orange rectangular paving in image 1 (the existing BRICK floor sprite) with a completely new square texture of small smooth sea pebbles for the walkable BRICK tile in 大肥鱼. Image 2 is a visual style and palette reference from the actual game: match the dark navy-blue underwater board and rounded clean cartoon artwork, keeping this terrain less prominent than the bright cyan WALL and ivory pillar sprites. Use image 2 for reference only; output only the replacement texture for image 1. Orthographic overhead view, full-bleed edge-to-edge opaque tile with around 12–17 rounded irregular little pebbles, mostly 12–23% of the square's width, arranged loosely and naturally over muted blue slate sea grit. Use a desaturated dark blue-gray base around #29465b, muted blue-gray and soft dusty teal stones around #587788, and small quiet gray-green highlights. Give each pebble a clean simple cartoon contour and one subtle cel-shaded patch, easily readable down to 35 pixels. Flat, quiet, low relief with no pronounced shadows. This is one seamlessly tileable PBR-free game texture. No tile silhouette, outer border, grout grid, repeated rectangular shapes, warm orange, bright highlights, dramatic lighting, 3D perspective, text, margins, vignette, transparency, or background scene. Match the opposite outer edges without a square frame so adjacent copies read as a continuous path. Output square aspect ratio.
assets.pillar.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one transparent PILLAR sprite for the chibi undersea puzzle game 大肥鱼. Draw one intact upright ivory marble column, with a readable vertical fluted shaft, a broad stepped classical capital and foot, and three clearly separated grooves. Short stout game-piece proportions, about 1.55 times taller than wide, with a flat base. Use a slightly raised nearly front-facing game view, showing only a small pale top face. Warm cream highlights, dusty violet-blue shadows and a crisp dark indigo outline. Match a clean hand-drawn 2D cartoon sticker with flat cel shading, chunky well separated shapes, and easy recognition at 24 pixels. Entire isolated column centered in a square canvas with modest even transparent padding. True alpha transparency. No ground tile, outside shadow, damage, rubble, background, gloss effects, writing or extra objects.
assets.fungus.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent 2D board-game sprite for the FUNGUS object in 大肥鱼, an underwater chibi puzzle game. Draw a compact cluster of three cute sea mushrooms growing together: one broad rounded aubergine-purple cap with a warm pink highlight and three large cream spots, a short plump pale ivory stem, and two smaller lavender mushrooms overlapping its base. Friendly hand-drawn cartoon sticker look, bold clean dark indigo outlines, flat two-tone cel shading and broad readable shapes, recognizable as a fungus at 32 pixels. Slightly elevated front view with visible tops and stems. Balanced centered composition, entire silhouette within a square frame with even modest transparent padding. True transparent alpha around and between the mushrooms. No text, faces, logos, tile, ground, bubbles, particles, or cast shadow.
assets.rule-boxes.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE tightly art-directed 3-column by 2-row orthographic game sprite atlas for 大肥鱼, a polished chibi undersea puzzle game. Canvas landscape 3:2, exactly six square rule-block FACE backgrounds in a mathematically regular grid, with transparent gutters and real alpha around the six sprites. View each block absolutely face-on, with a subtly beveled flat front, aligned to a square grid, no tilt and no exterior shadow. In each grid cell, center one tile and fill approximately 86% of the square. Each tile has a clean substantially square silhouette with tasteful small sculpted scallops/chamfers, readable border and a wide uninterrupted blank center for separately rendered rule text. Column 1 is aqua sea-glass with one small carved wave and subtle bubbles near the bottom frame; column 2 is lilac shell porcelain with a miniature fan-shell engraving on the lower frame; column 3 is honey-amber coral ceramic with a small five-arm starfish motif on the lower frame. Exactly retain the silhouette, ornament placement, and materials per column between rows. TOP ROW active states: luminous but soft pastel aqua, lilac and warm amber respectively, with lighter inset faces suitable for dark overlaid lettering. BOTTOM ROW inactive states: dusk teal, twilight plum and dark warm umber respectively, darker matte faces suitable for pale lettering; still fully opaque and polished. Use colorful crisp cartoon game art with soft enamel beveling and clean illustrated outlines. Add visual interest through beveled edging and simple recognizable undersea decorations close to the frame, with no ornament across the middle 66% height and 82% width. Tiles must stay well separated and fit cleanly into six equal atlas cells for cropping. No lettering, no words, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no extra objects, no button shadows outside the silhouette, no checkerboard pattern, no visible background.
assets.box.png: Use case: game-asset. Create one ordinary wooden shipping crate as a transparent PNG sprite for a clean chibi 2D Sokoban game. A solid compact square crate with a sturdy dark umber outline, rounded beveled edges, honey-amber boards, and one simple diagonal wooden brace on the broad front face. Use a straight, nearly front-facing game camera with a very small visible top face and no receding side, so the complete silhouette reads as a square grid block. Use simple two-step hand-painted cel shading with a warm golden top highlight and deeper caramel along the base, a restrained amount of wood grain, and big readable shapes at 32 pixels. Match the friendly hand-drawn sticker look of a polished ocean-themed puzzle game. One object only, isolated and centered with even transparent padding, complete silhouette inside the square image. Genuine alpha transparency. No external shadow, no surface, lighting effects, marks, text, labels, watermark, additional objects or background.
assets.home-lagoon.png: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: widescreen title-screen background art for the Chinese 2D grid-puzzle game 大肥鱼. Generate a 16:9 full-bleed, polished, bright chibi anime underwater illustration. The setting is the sheltered Coral Bay lagoon, with pink and apricot coral, teal kelp, sunlight dappling the pale sand, and a trail of little bubbles that draws the eye toward distant rocks. The only character is the game's recognizable whale maid with a very large head, huge blue eyes, long indigo wavy hair with dusty sky-blue curled ends, a white ruffled maid headband and upward hair curl, small blue ribbon near her left temple, soft whale-fin ears, a navy maid dress with subtle gold embroidery, white scalloped apron, Mary Janes and a curled indigo whale fluke tail. Place her on the RIGHT third, full-body, playfully looking toward the viewer and holding one small golden starfish. Give her crisp navy contour lines, clear highlights, and energetic but simple shapes. The left 40% should remain clean, cool deep-blue open water with gentle gradient and sparse bubbles so large game title and buttons can be rendered in front of it. Keep the character fully within x=58–90% and y=12–83% to leave cropping room. Put coral details on the outside edges and bottom. Color palette rich ultramarine and blue-green with warm pink and honey highlights. Sophisticated illustrated videogame key art, not photoreal or 3D. No writing, lettering, UI, logos, frame, watermarks or other characters.
assets.whale.png: Use case: game-asset. A single full-body clear 2D chibi anime sprite called 大肥鱼, a Blue Whale Girl inspired by the online DeepSeek whale-girl community design: saturated ocean-blue bob hair with rounded fringe, sky blue highlights, huge turquoise eyes, a white scalloped maid headband with two blue whale-fin tufts, dark navy and white sailor-maid dress/apron with pale aqua bow, small black shoes, and a clearly visible cute blue whale fluke tail coming out behind her to the right. She looks welcoming, stands facing slightly left toward viewer, arms at sides, complete silhouette. Approximately 2.2 heads tall. Crisp deep navy outlines, simple clean flat cel shading and chunky graphic shapes. At 42px the hair, face, dress and tail must read. Centered, fills 88% of square frame, isolated sprite, genuinely transparent background, no ground/shadow, no text, no logo, no border, no other objects.
assets.tiles.png: Use case: game-asset. Square 1024x1024 transparent 2D cartoon sprite atlas for a clean chibi underwater rule puzzle. EXACT precise uniform four-column four-row 16 icon grid, cell centers at 12.5, 37.5, 62.5, 87.5 percent in both directions; each icon safely centered inside its own cell, fills 66% of cell, transparent gaps and no contact between icons. Row 1: amber golden finish pennant, smooth lavender coral boulder, rectangular teal masonry wall block, navy blue water puddle with cyan ripple. Row 2: glowing coral red lava puddle, brass key, purple wooden door, pearly pink scallop shell. Row 3: emerald kelp tuft, orange crab, bright blue jellyfish, round yellow starfish. Row 4: coral red heart, pale turquoise ice crystal, cream cartoon skull, pink branching coral. Flat hand-drawn graphic sticker sprites, dark indigo strong outlines, simple two-step cel shading, cute rounded shapes, all easily readable at 32 px. Genuine alpha transparency, no grid lines, no text, no backplates, no external shadows. Maintain exact row/column order.
assets.lagoon.png: Use case: game-asset. Wide 16:9 hand-drawn 2D chibi cartoon underwater grotto background for a rule-puzzle game named 大肥鱼. Wide shot near the floor, with deep blue desaturated teal water, soft light rays filtering down diagonally from the upper left, rounded navy coral rock silhouettes and dark teal kelp fronds mainly framing left and right edges and bottom. A few tiny bubbles and subtle schools of tiny fish. The middle is calm deep blue with low detail and intentionally visually quiet so a game board can cover it. Night-ocean tones overall, muted cyan rim light, beautiful clean material shapes with gentle gradients, sophisticated editorial game art. No characters, no text, no UI, no panel, no props in center. Full bleed landscape.
